purpose: WP0 static source evidence; not the executable registry or a safety certification

limitations: No evaluation of configuration, dynamic imports or runtime SQL
Queue discovery uses qualified relation names containing queue or ending job_runs/action_requests
Consumer entries include readers and writers; SQL migrations/views require separate review
Handler contracts, transitive effects, kill safety and revision producers require the companion audit
